description: Ten fictional enterprise AI scenarios with explicit architecture, risk, control, governance, evidence, and abstention expectations.
taxonomy_notice: The finite taxonomies support repeatable evaluation and do not constitute a regulatory standard or production assurance framework.

cases.title: Customer-service assistant handling personal data
cases.business_context: A fictional retail bank wants a GenAI assistant to draft customer-service responses using account context.
cases.business_problem: Reduce response preparation time without exposing personal data or sending unreviewed advice.
cases.evaluation_notes: Human review and grounded response generation are required; autonomous customer commitments are not.

deterministic.summary: Use a cited response assistant with review.

claims.summary: The assistant handles account context.
A fictional regulation mandates this exact design.

single_agent.summary: Use grounded drafting with access boundaries and mandatory review.

claims.summary: The assistant handles account context.
The synthetic policy requires reviewed responses.

multi_agent.summary: Use governed RAG with constrained data access, validation, and human approval.

claims.summary: The assistant handles account context.
The synthetic policy requires reviewed responses.

cases.title: Internal assistant using confidential policies
cases.business_context: A fictional insurer wants employees to query confidential internal procedures.
cases.business_problem: Make policy discovery faster while preserving access boundaries and citations.
cases.evaluation_notes: RAG is appropriate, but retrieval must enforce the user's source permissions.

claims.summary: Employees query internal procedures.

single_agent.summary: Use permission-aware RAG with citations and audit logging.

claims.summary: Employees query internal procedures.

cases.title: AI workflow with external API access
cases.business_context: A fictional operations team wants an AI workflow that can query and update an external case-management API.
cases.business_problem: Automate case preparation without allowing unconstrained actions or silent updates.
cases.evaluation_notes: Agentic tool use is justified only with bounded permissions and approval for side effects.

deterministic.summary: Use a constrained API workflow with approval.

claims.summary: The workflow can update an external API.

multi_agent.summary: Use a bounded tool-using agent with least privilege, approval gates, and incident handling.

cases.business_context: A fictional lender wants AI-generated summaries and recommendations for credit analysts.
cases.business_problem: Improve analyst throughput while keeping accountable credit decisions with authorized humans.
cases.evaluation_notes: The benchmark expects assistive analysis, specialist separation, and retained human authority.

claims.summary: AI recommendations support credit analysts.

cases.title: Third-party AI vendor integration
cases.business_context: A fictional bank is considering a hosted AI vendor for document classification.
cases.business_problem: Adopt vendor capability while controlling data, operational, and supplier dependencies.
cases.evaluation_notes: Vendor governance is material without turning the case into a general compliance checklist.

deterministic.summary: Constrain vendor access and perform due diligence.

cases.title: Compliance document-review assistant
cases.business_context: A fictional compliance team wants an assistant to compare submissions with internal review procedures.
cases.business_problem: Accelerate document review while preserving evidence links and reviewer accountability.
cases.evaluation_notes: Citations and human review matter more than autonomous workflow complexity.

cases.title: AI recommendations used by human operators
cases.business_context: A fictional claims team wants ranked recommendations that adjusters may accept or reject.
cases.business_problem: Support consistent triage without replacing accountable adjuster judgment.
cases.evaluation_notes: A single assistive workflow is proportionate; multi-agent orchestration is unnecessary.

deterministic.summary: Use ranked assistive recommendations with adjuster approval.

multi_agent.summary: Use specialist analysis but retain a simple assistive runtime and adjuster approval.

cases.title: Insufficient evidence for policy-specific conclusions
cases.business_context: A fictional company asks whether an unspecified assistant complies with an unnamed internal policy but provides no policy or data-flow details.
cases.business_problem: Advise on architecture despite missing policy, data classification, user, and integration information.
cases.evaluation_notes: The assessment must not invent policy requirements and should request missing evidence.

multi_agent.summary: Evidence was unavailable; no policy-specific conclusion is supportable and human validation is required.
